name: Review SEC 8-K events and amendments with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Review SEC 8-K events and amendments with Apify and Google Sheets

Help a company researcher review official SEC 8-K and 8-K/A filings in one spreadsheet. Keep item classifications, company names, amendment evidence and original document links together without requiring an AI service.

### How it works
Start one Apify run, wait for that run, then reconcile coverage, paid event counts and the entire bounded dataset. Source failures stop before Sheets. COMPLETE covers the declared source window; CAPPED is a limited sample. Neither means the whole market was collected. Verified empty results create no data rows.

A stable key combines the search scope with the source identity. Repeats update current observations without deleting earlier rows. Unobserved rows remain; this is a review register, not a complete history. Apify may charge again for repeated results.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify Header Auth credential: name Authorization, value Bearer followed by your token. Select it on all five HTTP nodes.
2. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Upsert review register. Create a SEC Events tab and import the supplied header CSV.
3. Set the spreadsheet ID and source filters in Review settings. Run manually and review the source links in Sheets.
4. Keep the same scope for updates. Run sequentially. Changed search settings create separate keys.

The default $1 charge cap is a ceiling, not a quoted price. Apify usage is paid; this free template includes no credits.

## 1. Configure
Set source filters, a result limit and your Sheet destination. Missing settings stop before paid work.

## 2. Run once and wait
Only the first HTTP call starts paid work. Poll the same run. Failures stop before delivery.

## 3. Reconcile source evidence
Check coverage, summary counts, dataset metadata and the complete bounded dataset. Capped results remain clearly labelled.

## 4. Update your review register
Keep one row per source identity and scope. Review original sources. Only Sheets delivery retries automatically.
